name: Kagari Shinichi
source: He is trusted by his students for his strict lectures getting the results they need. His cool demeanor attracts many fans. The one thing he can't stand is bad teaching. Underneath those glasses is a whole different side of him. At school, he's strict to everyone including himself. But at home, he's laidback..?! When you try to wake him up, he pulls you down to him... Could it be that he has a softer side?
